The decisive mistake was at step 6, by Whitney_Collection_Expert. The searches in steps 2 and 4 had not surfaced the 2022.128 record. At that point the agent needed to retrieve the record itself, for example by querying the Whitney's open-access dataset or its collection page directly. Instead it only drafted an email to the museum, which the team could not send and which produced no information. The photograph, book and author were never identified, and the team drifted into generic searches and an unsupported guess (Thomas Morris) at step 9.
